summary: Handles the creation, execution, rendering, and validation of file updates and merges for docstrings.
responsibilities: Build and apply file update plans and merge plans for docstrings.
Validate updated sources using formatting and linting tools.
relationships: Docstring update planning depends on building update plans and merge plans, rendering docstrings, and validating sources.
design_decisions: Encapsulates modules for building, merging, applying, and validating file and docstring updates using formatting and check tools.
